# Concept: Cognitive Ledger

## Statement

The cognitive ledger is a personal knowledge management system that stores structured facts, preferences, goals, and open loops as searchable notes.

## Context

Unlike a general note-taking tool, the cognitive ledger categorises notes by type (facts, preferences, goals, concepts, open loops).
Retrieval is the core capability: the ledger can answer questions by searching and ranking relevant notes.
The system is designed to be an external memory that complements natural human cognition.
The cognitive-ledger project is Alex's implementation of this concept using Python.
